state.question: Six people cross a bridge with one torch at night. Times are 1,3,8,12,17,24 minutes. At most two cross together; every crossing requires the torch. A pair takes the slower time. Someone carries the torch back when needed, at the same individual times. What is the minimum total time to get everyone across?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.
